title: Wynncraft - Ethereal Zenith Stance
description: Turns Battle Monk's Ultimate into plasma.
body:
# Mild photosensitivity warning
Effects can be lightened by unzipping the pack -> increasing the "frametime" value found inside ```assets\minecraft\textures\item\custom\ethereal_zenith_stance.png.mcmeta```

## Requires reordering of server resource packs. 
<details>
<summary>Working Solutions and Technical Details</summary>
  
- https://modrinth.com/mod/serverpack-priority
- https://modrinth.com/mod/server-pack-unlocker
- https://modrinth.com/mod/wynntils (For Wynncraft's resource pack only. Requires you to log off Wynncraft and rejoin. Might require additional rejoins when switching worlds.)
</details>

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/XKTxHmxgkng" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

<details>
<summary>Disclaimers</summary>

For use only on Wynncraft (play.wynncraft.com).

NOTE: Wynncraft updates the resource pack quite often, and their internal model indexing changes as a result. I can't guarantee that this resource pack will always properly display the fists.

</details>



Eyerok is retiring from being an ult. Master the arts with searing ethereal plasma instead! Models were built upon Wynncraft team's existing models for Zenith Stance. 

(...Eyerok is owned by Nintendo. Just in case.)
